Fragrance.definition: Mixture of aromatic compounds used to add scent; exact composition is often undisclosed.

Cocamidopropyl Betaine.definition: Amphoteric surfactant/foaming agent derived from coconut oil.

Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate.definition: Mild anionic surfactant made from coconut fatty acids.
Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate.concerns: Generally mild; irritation at high concentrations.

Sodium Laureth Sulfate.definition: Anionic surfactant/cleanser that creates rich lather.
Sodium Laureth Sulfate.concerns: Can be drying/irritating in some users.

Sodium Lauryl Sulfate.definition: Strong anionic surfactant and foaming agent.
Sodium Lauryl Sulfate.concerns: More irritating than SLES for many people.

Dimethicone.definition: Silicone polymer that forms a smooth protective film.
Dimethicone.concerns: Build-up for some hair types; generally low irritation.

Cyclopentasiloxane.definition: Volatile silicone that gives slip and quick-dry feel.

Dimethiconol.concerns: Build-up on hair; generally low irritation.

Behentrimonium Chloride.definition: Cationic conditioning agent; detangling and softening.
Behentrimonium Chloride.concerns: Irritation possible if left on scalp for long periods.

Cetyl Alcohol.definition: Fatty alcohol that thickens and softens.
Cetyl Alcohol.concerns: Generally safe; not a drying alcohol.

Cetearyl Alcohol.definition: Blend of cetyl and stearyl alcohols for slip and body.
Cetearyl Alcohol.concerns: Low irritation; different from drying alcohols.

Glycerin.definition: Humectant that attracts water to skin/hair.

Hyaluronic Acid.concerns: Can feel tacky; low irritation risk.

Niacinamide.definition: Multitasker for tone, oil control, and barrier support.
Niacinamide.concerns: Flush in rare cases at high concentration.

Panthenol.definition: Humectant and soothing agent; adds slip to hair.

Shea Butter.concerns: Heavy for fine hair; acne-trigger for some.

Methylparaben.definition: Preservative class used to inhibit microbial growth.
Methylparaben.concerns: Debate over endocrine effects; many choose to avoid.

BHT.definition: Antioxidant that stabilizes oils and formulas.
BHT.concerns: Some prefer to avoid due to irritation/tox debates.

Triclosan.commonUses: Soaps, some pastes (restricted in many regions)

Oxybenzone.definition: Chemical UV filter for broad-spectrum protection.
Oxybenzone.concerns: Allergy potential; environmental concerns; often avoided.

Avobenzone.concerns: Can degrade without stabilizers; eye sting for some.

Octocrylene.concerns: Allergy potential for a subset of users.

Homosalate.concerns: Regulatory review in some regions; personal preference.

Zinc Oxide.definition: Mineral UV filter; broad-spectrum and photostable.

Titanium Dioxide.concerns: White cast; inhalation concerns for loose powders.

Quaternium-15.definition: Preservative that can release small amounts of formaldehyde.

Polyquaternium-11.definition: Film-forming polymer for hold and gloss.

Alcohol Denat..concerns: Drying/irritating on skin/hair in higher amounts.

Limonene.concerns: Allergen potential; oxidizes on air exposure.
